kb.title: Living books
kb.lead: Turn this knowledge base into a book: an outline you edit and confirm, then chapters of explanations, examples, quizzes and cards written from your own documents, each citing them.
kb.goalPlaceholder: What should the book get you to?
kb.cost: Proposing the outline is one call on your key. Nothing else is written until you confirm it and open a chapter.

book.compileAllCost: About {{count}} call on your key, in the background.
book.compileAllCost_other: About {{count}} calls on your key, in the background.
book.deleteConfirm: Delete this book, its chapters and its cards? Questions it added to your bank stay there.

editor.lead: Edit the outline: rename, reorder, cut or add chapters, and choose the passages each is written from. Then confirm it. Confirming creates the chapters; nothing is written until you open one.
editor.title: Title
editor.confirmHint: Confirm saves the outline first. Every chapter needs a title, an objective and a passage.

chapter.stale: Sources changed since this was written. Refresh.
chapter.costMax: Up to {{count}} calls on your key: one to plan it, one per block.
chapter.compiling: Writing this chapter… the page updates as blocks are written.
chapter.busy: Another chapter of this book is being written; wait for it, or cancel it from the book.

block.regenerateCost: One call on your key. The current version stays until the new one is ready.
block.failed: This block could not be written: {{reason}}
block.updating: Being rewritten; this is the previous version.
block.noQuestions: No questions are left in this block.
block.addToReviewHint: In review, these cards come back in Mastery → Book cards on their own schedule.

errors.regenerateFailed: The block was not rewritten; the previous version is kept.
